The "'''World Below'''" was the name given to a lost [[City/Legends|city]] underneath the surface of the<ref name="TOR" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trif]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the World Below had become viewed as just a legend. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], a series of massive [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] opened a fissure leading to the city, proving its existence.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "The World Below" was released with the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion, it must therefore take place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref> an individual associated with one of the two sides in the Galactic War sent a companion of theirs to explore the World Below.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The World Below was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "The World Below" which was released as part of the [[2014]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
